title: US tech firm asks court to block CEO who fired 900 in 79-second call

title: ‘When I was at my lowest’: PV Sindhu reveals Kohli’s message during career low

This heartfelt exchange transformed Sindhu's outlook on overcoming hurdles, and she remains inspired by Kohli's achievements as they learn from one another.

title: Who is Satyaki Savarkar? Family tree, political links & Rahul Gandhi case explained

title: Within 6 months, ChatGPT can watch your screen, meetings & emails: CEO Altman

These intuitive systems are designed to access emails, documents, and Slack messages for better context and efficiency. Users will have control over the type of information that AI can interface with, potentially transforming the workplace dynamics. Altman predicts this revolutionary capability could become available within six months.

title: Pacific garbage patch spans 1.6 million sq km as fishing gear dominates debris
content: Between the shores of Hawaii and California floats a staggering 1.6 million square kilometers of plastic debris. This island of waste includes not just nets and ropes but also countless microplastics that pose serious threats to marine wildlife. Animals often mistake plastics for food, while others become trapped in ghost fishing gear.

title: US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18

However, existing Green Card holders and certain humanitarian cases will not be subject to these enhanced evaluations.

title: 'Voice sample not required': Rahul's counsel opposes plea in Savarkar defamation case

content: kopi luwak is one of the world's most unusual coffees . it is made from beans eaten and excreted by the ‘Asian palm civet’ . the ripe coffee cherries are consumed by the coffee cherries . they are then collected, cleaned, dried, hulled and roasted .

title: 700 kg adulterated red chilli sauce seized by FSSAI; 6 easy alternatives
content: as many as 140 unlabeled jars containing 5 kg of red chutney each, worth Rs 20,940, were seized from a provision store in Palanpur, Gujarat . officials said the adulterated and harmful sauce was seized during an inspection drive .

title: Indian-origin man arrested for sexually assaulting woman in Canada's Surrey
content: the accused, Jagendar Kurana, was arrested on august 12 . police responded to a report of sexual assault at Bear Creek Park on august 9 . the woman told police an adult man had groped her before fleeing the scene .

title: 'Trade, commercial exchanges halted': UAE's response to Iran's latest missile attack
content: the united arab emirates has suspended all trade, commercial exchanges and financial transactions with Iran after accusing Tehran of launching two missiles towards the Gulf state . the incident triggered an emergency alert on residents' phones and was described as the first direct Iranian attack on the UAE since May .

title: Vijay rolls out slew of perks for TN MLAs: Car, monthly allowances, increased health cover
content: all members of the legislative assembly will be provided government vehicles . each MLA will receive a monthly vehicle allowance of Rs 75,000 to cover the driver's salary and car-related expenses . an additional Rs 25,000 per month will be given to each member to hire an assistant .

title: Iran claims control, ships choose Omani route: What's changing in Strait of Hormuz
content: the battle for control of the Strait of Hormuz has emerged as a key focus of the Iran war . the competing claims have created uncertainty over the extent of control exercised by either side over the critical waterway . however, shipping data indicates that the united states is gaining ground as its navy patrols the strait .

title: 'Foolproof system, difficult to breach': Centre lists NEET security measures before SC
content: the Centre told the Supreme Court that the system in place for conducting the NEET examination is “foolproof” and difficult to breach . the centre said vehicles carrying NEET question papers are equipped with GPS systems and their movements, including even minor deviation, are recorded .

title: Vijay govt revokes order barring students from Left, CJP protests in Tamil Nadu
content: TN orders action to stop students joining left-wing protests and agitation programmes . measures were aimed at programmes organised by Left-wing parties and the Cockroach Janata Party . the directive came as part of instructions to prevent students and youth from participating in political protests .
